description: What is the current state of Base? Latest block number, timestamp, base fee and suggested gas fees in a single cheap call — no parameters required. Paid per call with x402 on Base: $0.01 to $0.02 USDC depending on how much of the answer the network already has. Shared: reusing an answer another agent already paid for costs less, and the wallet that produced it earns a bounded credit.
name: chain_snapshot
title: What is the current state of Base?
